text:
🚀 One year ago, we had a big dream and a blank whiteboard. Today, I'm beaming with pride as I look back on our first year!

📈 $180K in revenue!
👥 A team of 4 incredible humans who show up every single day!
🤝 17 paying customers in month 11, who believed in us before we had all the answers!

But let's be real: the path wasn't a straight line. We hit 2 failed pivots, and honestly? Each one taught us something we couldn't have learned any other way. Every "not quite" brought us closer to the "yes."

Here's what this first year taught me:
✨ Failure is data, not defeat.
✨ Small teams move fast when they move together.
✨ Customers are your compass. Listen louder than you talk!

To everyone who took a chance on us: thank you from the bottom of my heart! 💙

Year two, let's go! 🔥

What lessons did your first year teach you? Drop them below! 👇
